tweet.text:
Even if we accept for the moment that CG giving $10m to a $38m RAND/METR collaboration (of which METR got $17m) is the same as CG giving $10m to METR, you claimed that CG gave METR most of their funding, and also that CG gives them money "every year". $10m isn't most of their funding! They received $71m in the last 6 months alone! https://metr.org/blog/2026-08-14-funding-update/

METR is mostly funded by a handful of very rich EAs at Jane Street and a mix of other foundations AFAIK.
